name: Aphids
signs: Clusters of small soft-bodied insects, curled leaves and sticky honeydew.
firstSteps: Hose off light infestations, encourage beneficial insects and inspect new growth regularly.

name: Cabbage moth / white butterfly
signs: Chewed brassica leaves, holes and green caterpillars.
firstSteps: Inspect leaf undersides, remove caterpillars by hand and use fine insect netting to prevent egg laying.

name: Snails and slugs
signs: Irregular holes, missing seedlings and shiny trails.
firstSteps: Check after dark or rain, remove hiding places and protect vulnerable seedlings.

name: Powdery mildew
signs: White powdery patches on leaves, common on cucurbits.
firstSteps: Improve airflow, water soil rather than leaves and remove badly affected foliage.

name: Blossom end rot
signs: Dark sunken patch at the blossom end of tomatoes, capsicums or zucchini.
firstSteps: Keep soil moisture consistent and avoid damaging roots; calcium uptake problems are often moisture-related.
